# Connor Conkey-Morrison

::: hero-tags
[PhD Candidate]{.tag} [Provisional Psychologist]{.tag} [Sessional Academic]{.tag}
:::

::: hero-bio
I work across psychology, education, and digital health, with a particular interest in how evidence becomes useful to people and systems. My PhD examines school attendance problems from intervention research through to Australian cohort and education-system data.
:::

## Featured & upcoming

[ATN National Symposium 2026](https://events.humanitix.com/atn-national-symposium-2026){.about-link}

### The stubborn art of being human

I’ll be speaking on the student panel, **[Re]claiming the art of learning in an AI-enabled world**, at the free ATN Universities symposium on Thursday 19 November. Join online or in person at RMIT University, Melbourne, from 11:00 am to 4:30 pm AEDT.

[Register for free →](https://events.humanitix.com/atn-national-symposium-2026){.about-link}

## Current focus

My current research connects intervention evidence, longitudinal modelling, and population-level education data. The wider portfolio also includes behavioural addiction, digital health, measurement, and applied psychology.
